# stalwart_mta_stage_mail (Resource)

Configures MAIL FROM stage processing and sender validation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `is_sender_allowed` (Attributes) Expression that returns true when the sender is allowed to send (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--is_sender_allowed))
- `rewrite` (Attributes) Expression to rewrite the sender address (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rewrite))
- `script` (Attributes) Which Sieve script to run after the client sends a MAIL command (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script))

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
